scenes.subject: Re: your audition
scenes.body:
Loved the Chekhov.
Bring something funny.
Under a minute. Thursday.

read.title: Being
read.text:
I have invented an
invaluable permanent
invalid called Bunbury,
in order that I may be
able to go down into the
country whenever I choose.

source.sql: select m.id, m.character_name, m.estimated_duration_seconds as secs, m.overdone_score, m.primary_emotion, m.tone, m.themes, m.text from monologues m join plays p on p.id=m.play_id where m.character_name ilike 'algernon%' and p.title ilike '%earnest%' order by m.estimated_duration_seconds
source.checked: select p.title, count(*) from monologues m join plays p on p.id=m.play_id where m.character_name ilike '%algernon%' group by 1  -> The Importance of Being Earnest, 3
source.public_domain: Wilde died 1900, play published 1895: text on screen is fine. Quoted lines are verbatim from rows 4236, 4232 and 4237.
